_comment: Copy this to characters.json to use it. That file is gitignored and never
overwritten by the app -- it's yours.
Every field is optional. A slot with no entry here falls back to players.py
and the characters/player<N>-*.png naming convention, so you can convert one
slot at a time. Art paths are relative to static/.
"character": null empties a slot deliberately -- no art, nothing drawn.
